## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2012-03-05: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.31 to S-1/A Amendment No. 5.
- 2012-03-21: Vantiv Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed between Vantiv, Inc., the Advent Stockholders, and Advent International Corporation; 85% of Realized Tax Benefits on Section 743(b) basis adjustments from Advent's June 2009 acquisition of 50.93% of Vantiv Holding Class A Units from Fifth Third.
- 2012-05-08: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.7 to Q1 2012 10-Q.

#### Termination

- 2013-10-23: Tax Receivable Termination Agreement between Advent, Vantiv, and AIC; approximately $112M paid against an Advent TRA carrying balance of approximately $183.8M plus Advent's share of the NPC NOLs TRA.

## Explanation

This was one of four parallel TRAs Vantiv executed at its March 21, 2012 Up-C IPO. The Advent TRA compensated Advent for the Section 743(b) basis step-up generated when Advent acquired 50.93% of Vantiv Holding's Class A Units from Fifth Third in June 2009, at the pre-IPO restructuring; payments were 85% of Vantiv's Realized Tax Benefits from those step-ups. Unlike the Fifth Third and JPDN TRAs, this contract did not cover Imputed Interest because Advent already held Class A common stock at IPO and no post-IPO LLC exchanges were contemplated. The contract terminated on October 23, 2013 via a single Termination Agreement that simultaneously settled the Advent TRA and Advent's share of the NPC NOLs TRA for approximately $112M against a roughly $183.8M aggregate carrying balance. See `contract_log.md` for the parallel-TRA mapping and the full filing-by-filing record.
